subject: Resources for DWLS in ordinal sem

messages.author: cdb230595a7dc98b
messages.subject: Resources for DWLS in ordinal sem
parts:
Hi,
I am researching the inner resources of adolescents, using sem to determine directionality. I have ordinal measures and have decided not to use them as continuous variables for a number of reasons. The data are survey data and have some attrition. I have weighting variables but due to the data being ordinal, I cannot use Lavaan survey.

I’ve read all the lavaan paperwork for ordinal sem but I was wondering if there were any other resources that people can suggest in regards to decisions such as using pairwise versus listwise deletion where data may not be MCAR, so that I can note this in my thesis?

My models are pretty strong in regards to fit. I do have the warning regarding empty cells, but I am not concerned about this as all of my variables have five categories and I have the paper that indicates that Lavaan deals with this okay.
